note: Each entry documents a dataset examined during the Phase 1/2 audit of data.gov.my. `status: ingested` datasets have raw files under data/raw/ and processed outputs under data/processed/, produced by scripts/transform_data.py. `status: identified_not_ingested` datasets were confirmed to exist (URL + schema verified) but were not pulled into this build, usually because of sandbox network/data-volume constraints described in METHODOLOGY.md — scripts/ingest_data.py can fetch them directly once run in an environment with normal internet access.

datasets.name: Household Income (Malaysia)
datasets.description: Mean and median monthly gross household income, Malaysia, 1970-2024.
datasets.missingness: income_median missing for 1970 (survey did not report median that year)
datasets.recommended_use: National socioeconomic trend line (Overview page)
datasets.limitations: 1970-1974 Peninsular Malaysia only; Sabah/Sarawak from 1976; citizens only from 1989. Survey years are irregular, not annual.

datasets.name: Household Income by State
datasets.description: Mean/median household income by state, 1970-2024.
datasets.missingness: Federal Territories (Labuan, Putrajaya) only reported from 2007
datasets.recommended_use: State choropleth + ranking (Socioeconomic Inequality page)
datasets.limitations: Same survey-year irregularity as national series.

datasets.name: Household Income by District
datasets.description: Mean/median household income by administrative district.
datasets.missingness: None in the 3 available years for included districts
datasets.recommended_use: District-level choropleth map, the highest-resolution income indicator available
datasets.limitations: Only 3 cross-sectional years (2019/2022/2024), not a continuous series; do not interpolate between them.

datasets.name: Poverty Rate (Malaysia)
datasets.description: Absolute, hardcore and relative poverty rates, national, 1970-2024.
datasets.recommended_use: National trend (Overview, Socioeconomic Inequality)
datasets.limitations: Definitions of the Poverty Line Income have been revised over time by DOSM; pre/post-2019 PLI methodology differs — treat pre- and post-2019 absolute poverty rates as not fully comparable.

datasets.name: Poverty Rate by State
datasets.description: Poverty rates by state, 1970-2024.
datasets.missingness: Relative poverty missing pre-1995; some states missing hardcore poverty pre-1995
datasets.recommended_use: State choropleth (Health Equity Map, Socioeconomic Inequality)
datasets.limitations: Same PLI methodology caveat as hh_poverty.

datasets.name: Poverty Rate by District
datasets.description: Absolute & relative poverty rate by district.
datasets.recommended_use: District choropleth — highest-resolution poverty indicator available
datasets.limitations: Cross-sectional years only; hardcore poverty not published at district level.

datasets.name: Gini Coefficient (Malaysia)
datasets.description: National Gini coefficient of gross household income, 1970-2024.
datasets.recommended_use: National inequality trend
datasets.limitations: Based on gross income before tax/transfers.

datasets.name: Gini Coefficient by State
datasets.description: Gini coefficient by state, 1974-2024.
datasets.recommended_use: State choropleth + ranking
datasets.limitations: Gross income basis.

datasets.name: Gini Coefficient by District
datasets.description: Gini coefficient by district.
datasets.recommended_use: District choropleth
datasets.limitations: Cross-sectional years only.

datasets.name: Access to Basic Amenities by State & District
datasets.description: % of households with piped water, sanitary latrines, and electricity, by state and district.
datasets.missingness: A few remote Sabah/Sarawak districts (e.g. Kalabakan) have null electricity/piped_water in source
datasets.recommended_use: Basic-amenities choropleth, socioeconomic vulnerability domain
datasets.limitations: Only the 2022 cross-section was ingested in this build (see METHODOLOGY.md); 2016/2018/2020/2024 exist upstream and can be pulled by re-running ingest_data.py.

datasets.name: Population Table: States
datasets.description: DOSM intercensal population estimates by state, sex, age band and ethnicity.
datasets.date_range: Full series 1970-2026; this build ingested 2020-2023 (overall age/ethnicity, by sex)
datasets.recommended_use: Denominator for per-100,000 healthcare access rates
datasets.limitations: Full dataset also has 5-year age bands and 7 ethnicity categories; only 'overall age' x 'overall ethnicity' x sex was ingested in this build due to the raw file's size. Re-run ingest_data.py for full disaggregation.

datasets.name: Population Table: Administrative Districts
datasets.description: District population 2020-2024 by sex/age/ethnicity (official DOSM live series).
datasets.recommended_use: District population denominators for 2020-2024
datasets.limitations: NOT ingested in this build (raw file exceeds the sandbox fetch-size limit encountered during this session — see METHODOLOGY.md). The dashboard instead uses the DOSM census_district series (below) for district population, which only runs through 2020.

datasets.name: Census District Table (DOSM data-open GitHub mirror)
datasets.description: Historical census population by district, sex, ethnicity and broad age band, decennial + intercensal, 1970-2020.
variables: housing, marital, religion fields (not all used)
datasets.missingness: Many fields blank for pre-1991 census rounds (not all questions asked every census)
datasets.recommended_use: District population time series & structure (Population Equity page)
datasets.limitations: Only census years (1970,1980,1991,2000,2010,2020) plus a few intercensal points — not annual. Stops at 2020; use population_district (identified_not_ingested) for 2021-2024 if extending this pipeline.

datasets.name: Hospital Beds by State and Hospital Type
datasets.description: Public + non-MOH hospital bed counts, national/state/district, by facility type.
datasets.date_range: National/state series 2015-2022 ingested in full; district-level ingested for 2022 only
datasets.missingness: 0 recorded explicitly for districts with no hospital (not blank)
datasets.recommended_use: Healthcare Access page, beds-per-100,000 map
datasets.limitations: District-level series only ingested for 2022 (most recent year) in this build; full 2015-2022 district panel can be pulled by re-running ingest_data.py in an unrestricted network environment.

datasets.name: Healthcare Staff by State and Staff Type
datasets.description: Public-sector healthcare workforce (doctors, dentists, nurses, community nurses), national + state.
datasets.recommended_use: Healthcare workforce density map/ranking
datasets.limitations: Public sector only — excludes private-sector doctors/nurses, which are a significant share of urban healthcare capacity.

datasets.name: Annual Deaths by State
datasets.description: Crude death counts and rate by state of usual residence.
datasets.recommended_use: Mortality trend / equity map
datasets.limitations: State = deceased's usual residence, not place of death.

datasets.name: Annual Maternal Deaths by State
datasets.description: Maternal death counts and rate per 100,000 live births, by state.
datasets.recommended_use: Maternal health equity (Health Outcomes page)
datasets.limitations: Small annual counts per state -> rates are volatile year-to-year for smaller states; treat single-year state comparisons cautiously.

datasets.name: Annual Early Childhood Deaths by State
datasets.description: Perinatal, neonatal, infant, toddler and total under-5 death counts/rates, by state.
datasets.recommended_use: Infant/child mortality equity (Health Outcomes page)
datasets.limitations: Rate denominator differs by sub-type (per-1,000-live-births for infant/neonatal/perinatal; per-1,000-population for toddler) — do not compare rates across types directly.

datasets.name: Annual Live Births by State
datasets.description: Live birth counts and crude birth rate by state.
datasets.recommended_use: Denominator for maternal/infant mortality rates; fertility trend
datasets.limitations: State = mother's usual residence, not place of birth.

datasets.name: Infant Immunisation Coverage
datasets.description: Annual coverage rate for measles/MMR, DPT, Hepatitis B, polio.
joinable_with: nutrition_national via year (loosely, both national child-health series)
datasets.recommended_use: National immunisation trend (Health Outcomes page)
datasets.limitations: National level only — no state/district breakdown available from data.gov.my. Coverage can exceed 100% because it is aggregated-count-based, not individual-linked.

datasets.name: Nutritional Status of Children Under 5 by Sex
datasets.description: WHO-standard WAZ/HAZ/WHZ distribution (underweight/stunting/wasting/overweight prevalence) for under-5 children.
datasets.source_org: Ministry of Health Malaysia (National Health & Morbidity Survey)
datasets.recommended_use: Child nutrition equity by sex (Health Outcomes page)
datasets.limitations: Single cross-sectional year (2019); no state/district or ethnicity breakdown from this source.

datasets.name: Sexually Transmitted Diseases by State
datasets.description: Case counts and incidence (per 100,000) for HIV, AIDS, syphilis, gonorrhea, chancroid, by state.
datasets.recommended_use: Infectious-disease equity map (Health Outcomes page)
datasets.limitations: Reported/diagnosed cases only — true incidence, especially for HIV/AIDS, is understated due to under-testing; comparisons across states may partly reflect differences in testing access rather than true incidence.

datasets.name: HIV Incidence per 1,000 Uninfected Population (SDG 3.3.1)
datasets.description: New HIV infections per 1,000 uninfected population, by sex, national level only.
datasets.recommended_use: A methodologically cleaner HIV trend than std_state's crude diagnosed-case counts (denominator is uninfected population, not raw case counts) — no state breakdown though, so use alongside std_state rather than instead of it.
datasets.limitations: National only, no state or district breakdown. Complements but does not replace std_state.

datasets.name: Annual Stillbirths by State
datasets.description: Stillbirth counts and rate (per 1,000 total births) by state.
joinable_with: birth_state, death_maternal_state via state+year (merged into health_outcomes_state.json)
datasets.recommended_use: Perinatal-health equity alongside maternal/infant mortality on the Health Outcomes page.
datasets.limitations: A newly-added indicator to this project — not previously tracked.

datasets.name: Annual Deaths by State, Sex & Ethnicity
datasets.description: Death counts by state, sex, and ethnicity (bumi_malay, bumi_other, chinese, indian, other_citizen, other_noncitizen, plus DOSM's own "overall" cross-check total).
joinable_with: population_district via state+district+year (must be aggregated to state level first — see limitations)
datasets.recommended_use: The first dataset in this project that cross-tabulates ethnicity with a health outcome — see docs/DATA_SOURCES.md for the earlier (now outdated) finding that no such dataset existed. Shown as raw counts in the UI, not rates: this project has no state-level population-by-ethnicity dataset (population_state.json only breaks population down by sex, not ethnicity) — only population_district.json/population_district_full.json have an ethnicity breakdown, at district level. A per-capita rate would require summing those district-level ethnicity population figures up to state level first; until that's built, raw counts are shown with an explicit caveat rather than an uncomputed or fabricated rate.
datasets.limitations: Absolute counts only, no published per-ethnicity-group death rate, and no ready-made state-level ethnicity population denominator exists elsewhere in this project to compute one. The "overall" ethnicity value is DOSM's own cross-check total across the other six groups, not a distinct ethnicity — exclude it from any per-ethnicity comparison. Comparing raw counts across ethnic groups without population normalisation is misleading since group population sizes differ substantially — the UI must disclose this, not silently imply comparability.

datasets.name: Annual Deaths by District & Sex
datasets.description: District-resolution upgrade of death_state (which is state-only) — death counts and rate by district and sex.
datasets.recommended_use: District-level mortality equity comparisons, where death_state's state-only resolution is too coarse.
datasets.limitations: Shorter time range (2020-2024 only) than death_state (2000-2022) — a resolution upgrade, not a full historical replacement.

datasets.name: Annual Live Births by District & Sex
datasets.description: District-resolution upgrade of birth_state (which is state-only) — live birth counts and rate by district and sex.
datasets.recommended_use: District-level birth-rate context alongside deaths_district_sex, and a district-level denominator source for other district-level health outcomes.
datasets.limitations: Shorter time range (2020-2024 only) than birth_state (state-level, longer history) — a resolution upgrade, not a full historical replacement.

datasets.name: HIES 2019 State Snapshot (DOSM data-open GitHub mirror)
datasets.description: Cross-check snapshot: income, expenditure, gini and poverty rate by state, 2019, from DOSM's own published GitHub mirror.
joinable_with: socioeconomic_state.json (used as an internal consistency cross-check)
datasets.recommended_use: Data-quality cross-validation — used only to sanity-check the API-sourced hh_income_state/hh_poverty_state/hh_inequality_state figures for 2019, not loaded into the dashboard directly.
datasets.limitations: Single year, state-level only.

datasets.name: NCD Risk Factor Prevalence by State (NHMS 2015 + NHMS 2019 + NHMS 2023)
datasets.description: Prevalence of non-communicable-disease risk factors among adults, national and by state, across 3 survey cycles. 2015: 11 indicators (overall/known/undiagnosed diabetes, hypertension and hypercholesterolaemia, underweight, abdominal obesity, current smoking, physically active), crude prevalence, Sabah+W.P. Labuan reported as one combined unit. 2019: 13 indicators (adds overweight, obesity, current drinking, physical inactivity in place of physically-active), crude prevalence, full 16 states. 2023: 9 indicators (diabetes/hypertension/hypercholesterolaemia trio each split into overall/known/undiagnosed), age-standardised prevalence, full 16 states.
datasets.source_org: Institute for Public Health (IPH), National Institutes of Health, Ministry of Health Malaysia
variables: <indicator>_unreliable (bool, 2019 only, for indicators the source report itself flags as small-sample/high-RSE)

shared across years: known_diabetes, known_hypertension, raised_blood_glucose, raised_blood_pressure, raised_cholesterol, known_hypercholesterolaemia, undiagnosed_diabetes, undiagnosed_hypertension, undiagnosed_hypercholesterolaemia (undiagnosed_* populated for 2015 and 2023 only), underweight, abdominal_obesity, current_smoker
2015-only: physically_active (inverse framing of physical_inactivity, NOT the same field — not algebraically derived from it)
datasets.unit: % (weighted survey estimate; 2015/2019 have 95% CI, 2023 point estimate only)
datasets.missingness: 2015: no Sabah/W.P. Labuan rows (source reports them as one combined unit — splitting it would be fabrication, so both are null rather than guessed), no current_drinker (not disaggregated by state that cycle), no overweight/obesity (those table pages did not extract as text in this PDF in either pdftotext mode — likely image-rendered — and were not guessed at). 2019: none for the 16 states/FTs + national. 2023: state-level only for 9 indicators, no Malaysia row, no CI/n published in the source table.
joinable_with: socioeconomic_state.json, healthcare_access_state.json via state (for Determinants Explorer)
datasets.recommended_use: State-level NCD risk-factor outcomes for the Determinants Explorer (WHY) — the only survey-based (as opposed to administrative-registry) indicators in this dataset, and (for diabetes/hypertension/hypercholesterolaemia) the only indicators in the whole pipeline with three time points available for a before/after read
datasets.limitations: UNLIKE every other file in this pipeline, this dataset was not fetched from a data.gov.my/DOSM open-data endpoint — NHMS results are not published there. Every figure was manually transcribed from its respective Table X.Y in the relevant year's NHMS Technical Report PDF — see scripts/transform_data.py::build_nhms_ncd() for the exact table/page citation per indicator/year — each cross-checked against the report's own summary figures (2015 and 2019: Malaysia-level subtotal row in the same table; 2023: the report's own highest/lowest narrative sentences, which matched the extracted table exactly on every figure checked; 2015's physically_active table was additionally checked against its own "highest was Kelantan/Pahang" narrative sentence, which also matched exactly). Male/female-split columns were NEVER transcribed for any indicator/year because the source PDFs' two-column table layouts did not extract reliably enough to trust those numbers (2015/2019 used a mix of `pdftotext -layout` and `-raw` depending on which extracted that specific table cleanly; 2023's dedicated by-state tables extracted cleanly with `-raw`). Overweight/obesity use the WHO Asian (Malaysian CPG) BMI cutoffs, not the WHO international cutoffs also published alongside them in the source, in the years where they are present. current_drinker (2019 only) has several states flagged `_unreliable: true` (small sample / high relative standard error, as flagged with "*" in the source). **2015/2019 figures are crude prevalence; 2023 figures are age-standardised — these are NOT a precise apples-to-apples trend** across all three years, read any change as suggestive, not exact (2015 vs. 2019 IS on the same crude basis and is a fairer comparison). An NHMS 2011 (Vol. II) extraction attempt was abandoned after finding table titles frequently detached from their data by page-break artifacts in that specific PDF, and one spot-checked table's confidence interval did not exactly match the report's own stated CI (12.1–13.6 extracted vs. 12.2–13.5 stated) — a reliability risk this pipeline is not willing to accept without a cleaner source; 2011 is not included. NHMS 1996/2006 predate the comparable NCD survey series (per the 2019 report's own "11.2% (2011) -> 13.4% (2015) -> 18.3% (2019)" trend framing) and were not attempted.

datasets.name: Adolescent Depression, Anxiety & Stress by State (NHMS 2017, DASS-21)
datasets.description: Prevalence of depression, anxiety and stress (DASS-21 screening instrument) among secondary-school-going adolescents aged 13-17, national and by state.
datasets.source_org: Institute for Public Health (IPH), National Institutes of Health, Ministry of Health Malaysia
datasets.update_frequency: One-off (no repeat cycle identified as of this audit)
joinable_with: population_state.json via state (population context only — do NOT join against adult NCD indicators as if the same population)
datasets.recommended_use: The one youth-mental-health indicator in this pipeline — usable in the Determinants Explorer, but keep separate from nhms_ncd_state.json's adult indicators in any comparison
datasets.limitations: CRITICAL: this survey covers secondary-school-going ADOLESCENTS AGED 13-17, not adults and not the general population — it is a fundamentally different denominator from every other health indicator in this pipeline and must never be presented as if comparable to adult prevalence figures (e.g. adult diabetes or hypertension). School-based sampling also means adolescents not attending school (dropouts) are not represented. Manually transcribed from Tables 3.3.1/3.4.1/3.5.1 of the source PDF (not a data.gov.my/DOSM endpoint — same manual-transcription caveat as nhms_ncd_2019), cross-checked against the report's own stated highest-prevalence-state narrative for all three sub-scales (depression, anxiety, stress) — matched exactly. Single cross-sectional year (2017); no repeat cycle of this specific survey has been identified in the NHMS catalogue as of this audit, so no trend is possible.

datasets.name: DOSM Administrative Boundaries (state & district GeoJSON)
datasets.description: Official DOSM state and district administrative boundary polygons, used for the interactive choropleth map and to compute centroid coordinates for the geo lookup table.
joinable_with: all state/district datasets via state+district name
datasets.recommended_use: Choropleth map base layer; centroid coordinates for the geo_lookup table
datasets.limitations: Boundaries reflect the file's publication date; not guaranteed to match the very latest gazette changes.

datasets.name: Population by Parliamentary Constituency
datasets.description: Annual population estimates by federal parliamentary constituency (parlimen), by sex, 2020-2024.
datasets.missingness: none observed in the ingested slice
joinable_with: population_dun via parlimen name (DUNs nest within parlimen)
datasets.recommended_use: Table/ranking of constituency population size only — see limitations before using for choropleth mapping
datasets.limitations: No boundary GeoJSON for parliamentary constituencies exists in DOSM's open-data mirror, so this cannot be shown on the choropleth map — table/ranking display only. Kept to the 'overall citizenship, overall ethnicity' slice — despite its header name, the raw 'age' column in this source is actually citizenship status (citizen/noncitizen/overall), and there is no real age or ethnicity breakdown at all.

datasets.name: Population by State Legislative Assembly Constituency (DUN)
datasets.description: Annual population estimates by state legislative assembly constituency (DUN), by sex, 2020-2024.
datasets.geographic_resolution: DUN (state assembly constituency, 587 seats across Peninsular states + Sabah/Sarawak)
datasets.missingness: none observed in the ingested slice
datasets.recommended_use: Table/ranking of constituency population size only — see limitations before using for choropleth mapping
datasets.limitations: No boundary GeoJSON for DUN constituencies exists in DOSM's open-data mirror — table/ranking display only, no map. Kept to the 'overall citizenship, overall ethnicity' slice — despite its header name, the raw 'age' column in this source is actually citizenship status (citizen/noncitizen/overall), and there is no real age or ethnicity breakdown at all.

datasets.name: Population by District (2020-2025, current series)
datasets.description: Annual district-level population estimates by sex, 2020-2025 — DOSM's current post-census intercensal series, kept alongside (not replacing) the historical census_district-derived population_district.json already in the pipeline.
datasets.missingness: none observed in the ingested slice
datasets.recommended_use: Most current district population denominators (2020 onward); use the historical population_district.json for years before 2020
datasets.limitations: Kept to the 'overall age, overall ethnicity' slice — the source also has 5-year age bands and 7 ethnicity categories, not carried through in this pass. Two district-population files now coexist in the pipeline (this one and the historical census-derived one); consumers must pick the one matching their year range rather than assuming continuity.

datasets.name: Household Income by Percentile (Malaysia)
datasets.description: National household income distribution by percentile (1st-100th), by income variable, 2019-2024.
datasets.missingness: none observed in the ingested slice
datasets.recommended_use: Income-inequality visualisation beyond the mean/median already in hh_income (e.g. bottom-40 vs top-20 percentile gap)
datasets.limitations: National only — no state or district breakdown by percentile exists in the open catalogue. Survey years are irregular, not annual.

datasets.name: Marriages (Malaysia, national + state)
datasets.description: Annual registered marriages, absolute count and rate per 1,000 population, by sex, national and state, 2017-2022.
datasets.missingness: none observed in the ingested slice
datasets.recommended_use: Family-formation trend context alongside fertility_state
datasets.limitations: Registration-based (civil + Islamic registries combined per DOSM methodology) — does not capture unregistered unions.

datasets.name: Fertility Rates by State
datasets.description: Total fertility rate (TFR) and age-specific fertility rates (5-year bands, 15-49) by state, 2001-2024.
datasets.unit: TFR: births per woman; ASFR: births per 1,000 women in age band
datasets.missingness: none observed in the ingested slice
datasets.recommended_use: Reproductive-health / demographic-transition trend by state
datasets.limitations: age_group='tfr' rows are the summary total fertility rate, on a different scale (births per woman) from the 5-year-band rows (births per 1,000 women) — must be filtered/plotted separately, never averaged together.

datasets.name: Health Programme Participation by State (blood donation, organ pledges, PeKa B40 screenings)
datasets.description: Annual state totals of blood donations, organ-pledge registrations, and PeKa B40 (national health screening programme for B40 households) screenings, aggregated from daily source data.
datasets.source_org: Ministry of Health Malaysia (MOH) via data.gov.my
datasets.update_frequency: source is daily; aggregated here to annual
datasets.date_range: blood donations from 2006, organ pledges from 2009, PeKa B40 from 2019 — all through the latest available date (partial for the current year)
datasets.unit: count (annual sum of daily source values)
datasets.missingness: each indicator starts in a different year (see date_range); a state/year with no source rows for an indicator shows null, not 0
datasets.recommended_use: Health-system engagement / civic health-participation trend by state
datasets.limitations: The most recent year in each series is a partial year (source data continues to the ingestion date, not year-end) — do not compare the latest year's total to prior full-year totals without accounting for this. Organ pledges and screenings are counts of new registrations/events, not cumulative totals or unique individuals served.

datasets.name: COVID-19 Cases and Deaths by State
datasets.description: Annual state totals of confirmed COVID-19 cases (overall and by age band: child/adolescent/adult/elderly) and deaths, aggregated from daily case counts and an individual-level death line list, 2020-2025.
datasets.source_org: Ministry of Health Malaysia (MOH) via data.gov.my
datasets.update_frequency: source is daily; aggregated here to annual
datasets.missingness: 2025 is a partial year (data continues to the ingestion date); death counts derived by aggregating the individual-level line list, which has no confirmed-case-linkage field beyond state/date
joinable_with: health_outcomes_state via state+year (different domain — pandemic vs chronic-disease outcomes, join with care)
datasets.recommended_use: Pandemic-period outbreak burden by state, kept separate from the chronic-disease indicators in health_outcomes_state.json
datasets.limitations: Deliberately not merged into health_outcomes_state.json — COVID is an acute outbreak indicator, not a chronic NCD/mortality indicator, and mixing them would misrepresent both. covid_deaths_linelist is one row per death (not a count field), so death totals were derived by counting rows per state+year.

datasets.name: Malaysia National Health Accounts (MNHA)
datasets.description: Annual national health expenditure — total (teh) and current (ceh) health expenditure by sector (total/private/public), plus MOH-specific expenditure, 2013-2022.
datasets.source_org: Ministry of Health Malaysia (MOH) via data.gov.my
datasets.missingness: none observed in the ingested slice
datasets.recommended_use: Healthcare financing trend (new Financing page) — total/private/public expenditure and MOH's share
datasets.limitations: National only, no state breakdown exists in the open catalogue. The 'moh' variable is MOH's own public expenditure subset — it must never be summed with the teh/ceh totals, as that would double-count (MOH spending is already part of public sector expenditure in those totals).

datasets.name: Basic Sanitation Access by State (annual series)
datasets.description: Annual proportion of households with access to basic sanitation, by state, 2001-2022. A longer annual time series than the existing single-year (2022) district-level hh_access_amenities snapshot.
datasets.source_org: Department of Statistics Malaysia (DOSM) via data.gov.my
datasets.missingness: none observed in the ingested slice
joinable_with: healthcare_access_district_2022 (different geography level — state vs district, and different year)
datasets.recommended_use: State-level sanitation trend over time, complementing the single-year district snapshot
datasets.limitations: State-level only for this series — for district-level detail, use the existing 2022-only hh_access_amenities/healthcare_access_district_2022 dataset instead.

datasets.name: Basic Water Access by State (annual series, urban/rural)
datasets.description: Annual proportion of households with access to basic water supply, by state and urban/rural strata, 2000-2022.
datasets.source_org: Department of Statistics Malaysia (DOSM) via data.gov.my
datasets.missingness: none observed in the ingested slice
datasets.recommended_use: Urban/rural water-access equity gap by state over time
datasets.limitations: strata='overall' rows are a state-level summary, distinct from and not additive with the 'urban'/'rural' rows — filter by the strata field intentionally rather than mixing all three.

datasets.name: Household Electricity Access by Region
datasets.description: Annual count of households with electricity access, by utility-operator region, 2011-2021.
datasets.geographic_resolution: 4 utility-operator regions (Malaysia, Semenanjung Malaysia, Sabah, Sarawak) — NOT the standard 16-state schema
datasets.missingness: none observed in the ingested slice
joinable_with: none directly — region keys do not match the 16-state schema used elsewhere in this app
datasets.recommended_use: National/regional electrification trend only, shown as its own standalone table
datasets.limitations: Reports raw household counts, not a percentage or rate, and cannot be normalised without an independent regional household-count denominator. Deliberately kept in its own file (electricity_access_region.json) rather than force-joined onto the 16-state schema used by every other dataset in this app, since 'Semenanjung Malaysia' spans 11 states and cannot be disaggregated back to them from this source.

datasets.name: Nutrition Status of Children Under 5, Urban/Rural (2019)
datasets.description: Prevalence of underweight/stunting/wasting/overweight among children under 5, by urban/rural strata, national, 2019. Direct counterpart to the already-ingested sex-disaggregated nutrition_status_u5_sex.
datasets.source_org: Ministry of Health Malaysia (MOH) via data.gov.my
datasets.missingness: single year only — no trend possible
joinable_with: nutrition_national.json via year+indicator (sex vs strata are separate disaggregations of the same 2019 survey, not combinable into one cross-tab)
datasets.recommended_use: Urban/rural nutrition-equity comparison for under-5 children, alongside the existing sex-based comparison
datasets.limitations: Single year (2019) — cannot show a trend. Urban/rural and male/female are separate disaggregations from the same survey; the underlying microdata to cross-tabulate both at once is not in the open catalogue.

datasets.name: PeKa B40 Health Screenings by State (daily)
datasets.description: Daily count of PeKa B40 (national health screening programme for B40-household Malaysians aged 50+) screenings conducted, by state, 2019 to present. The day-level counterpart to health_programmes_state.json, which sums this same source to annual totals for cross-programme comparison.
datasets.source_org: Ministry of Health Malaysia (MOH) via data.gov.my / data.moh.gov.my
datasets.missingness: none observed in the ingested slice
joinable_with: health_programmes_state.json via state (health_programmes_state is the annual sum of this same series)
datasets.recommended_use: Recent screening-uptake trend by state (e.g. campaign response, day-to-day participation) — for year-over-year comparison, use health_programmes_state.json instead, which is already annually aggregated
datasets.limitations: The most recent days are close to the ingestion date and may still be subject to revision/backfill by the source. Raw daily counts are volatile (weekday/weekend and public-holiday effects) — a 7/30-day rolling view is more informative than any single day.

identified_but_not_yet_ingested.name: Older Persons Health — Diabetes, Hypertension, Hypercholesterolaemia, Dementia, Frailty (NHMS 2025)
identified_but_not_yet_ingested.reason: Confirmed during a 2026-08-13 check of iku.nih.gov.my/nhms2025: a new NHMS 2025 survey of adults aged 60+ exists, covering diabetes/hypertension/hypercholesterolaemia specifically in that age group plus dementia, cognitive impairment, depression, falls, frailty and caregiver burden — a genuinely new population subgroup (older persons) not otherwise represented in this dataset. Only a national-level fact sheet and key-findings infographic are published so far (iku.nih.gov.my/images/nhms-2025/factsheet_eng.pdf, checked directly — 0 state-name mentions across the whole document); no state-disaggregated technical report exists yet. Re-check this source when a full technical report is published — historically (NHMS 2019/2023) that has lagged the fact sheet by roughly a year.

identified_but_not_yet_ingested.name: NCD Risk Factor Prevalence by State (NHMS 2011, Vol. II)
identified_but_not_yet_ingested.reason: Attempted during the 2026-08-13 NHMS multi-year extraction (see nhms_ncd_2019's limitations field): NHMS 2011 Volume II (iku.nih.gov.my/images/IKU/Document/REPORT/NHMS2011-VolumeII.pdf) does contain state-level NCD tables in principle, but this specific PDF's text extraction repeatedly detached table titles from their data across page breaks, and the one table spot-checked against the report's own stated 95% CI showed a small mismatch (12.1-13.6 extracted vs. 12.2-13.5 stated) — high enough error risk that extraction was abandoned rather than risk publishing wrong figures. Would need a cleaner source (e.g. a non-scanned original, or manual page-by-page verification) to attempt again.
